brief.heading: What happens next
brief.body:
You'll sort some help-centre topics into groups, twice. It takes about 10 minutes.

There are no right or wrong answers. We're testing how the topics are organised, not you.

consent.heading: Before you begin
consent.text:
We record where you put each card, how long each sort takes and anything you type. We do not record your name: you are identified only by a code.

Your answers are kept on this device until the research team exports them, and are used only to improve the help centre. They are deleted 90 days after the study ends.

You can stop at any time, and ask us to delete your answers by quoting your code.

items.label: I've read how my answers will be used

hypotheses.statement: People group account and billing topics together, apart from delivery topics.
The proposed five sections hold every topic without a "miscellaneous" catch-all.

tasks.title: Group the topics your own way
tasks.scenario: Sort these help topics into groups that make sense to you, and give each group a name.

tasks.title: Place the topics in our sections
tasks.scenario: Put each help topic in the section where you'd expect to find it.
tasks.confidence: How confident are you that you'd find these topics in those sections?

cards.label: Get a refund for a missing item

closing.prompt: Was there a section you expected that wasn't there?

thanks.heading: Thank you
thanks.body: That's everything. Your answers help us organise the help centre.
